question: Which store has more customers?
sql: SELECT s.store_id, count(*) AS customers FROM customer c JOIN store s ON s.store_id = c.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much has each staff member collected in payments?
sql: SELECT st.first_name, st.last_name, sum(p.amount) AS collected FROM payment p JOIN staff st ON st.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY st.staff_id

question: Which films has the actor NICK WAHLBERG appeared in?
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'NICK' AND a.last_name = 'WAHLBERG'

question: How many customers does each country have?
sql: SELECT co.country, count(*) AS customers FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id

question: How many times was the film AGENT TRUMAN rented?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.title = 'AGENT TRUMAN'

question: What is the revenue of each film category?
sql: SELECT c.name, sum(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id

question: How many rentals were made in June 2005?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2005-06-01' AND rental_date < '2005-07-01'

question: Which customers are inactive? Give first and last names.
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE active = '0'

question: How many payments were made per month? Give month as YYYY-MM.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS month, count(*) AS payments FROM payment GROUP BY month

question: Hangi şehirde kaç müşteri var?
sql: SELECT ci.city, count(*) AS n FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id GROUP BY ci.city_id
